sources.title: Introducing Claude Opus 5.5
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The September 22 launch names Claude Opus 5.5 and compares it with Opus 5 and Fable 5.1. Its benchmark comparison table has no parameter column. Less serving compute and lower prices are efficiency statements, not nominal counts or a size-preserving base-model relationship.

sources.title: Claude Opus 5.5 - Claude Platform Docs
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The exact-model Specifications section lists model IDs, pricing, context/output token limits, thinking, modalities and availability, but no total or activated parameter count. Existing capability assessments remain supported.

sources.title: Claude Opus 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Fresh official PDF retrieved October 27, 2026 at 10:11:48Z and independently inspected as extracted text. Sections 1.1 and 1.4 describe pretraining, subsequent fine-tuning and evaluation snapshots without identifying a separately named size-bearing base. Table 8.1.A (page 174) compares benchmark scores, not parameter counts. Full-text searches for parameters, billion/trillion, model size, dense/MoE, architecture, fine-tuning and distillation found no nominal total or activated count; parameter hits concern evaluation settings.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: September 29, 2026 first-party article explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or customizable. Used only for distribution status.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: API service terms grant permission to use the service and reserve intellectual-property rights except as expressly stated. Combined with the nonpublic-weight statement, supports descriptive proprietary classification.

sources.title: PDF support
sources.evidence: Official PDF examples explicitly use claude-opus-5-5 with URL, base64 application/pdf and Files API document inputs. PDF processing extracts text and converts pages to images.

sources.title: Tool use with Claude
sources.evidence: Defines function calling and provides exact claude-opus-5-5 examples for both server tools and user-defined client tools, including structured tool_use and tool_result blocks.

sources.title: Anthropic Transparency Hub - Claude Opus 5.5 summary
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The exact Opus 5.5 summary still describes pretraining followed by post-training, but gives no nominal size, activated count or size-preserving named-base relationship. Text/image input and text output remain explicit.

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Fresh official PDF retrieved October 27, 2026 at 10:11:47Z and independently inspected as extracted text. Section 1.1, the Opus 5.5 column in Table 8.1.A (page 109), and full-text parameter/size/lineage searches disclose no total or activated count. The table reports task scores and effort/sampling configuration, not parameter sizes.

sources.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Fresh official PDF retrieved October 27, 2026 at 10:11:48Z and independently inspected as extracted text. Section 1.1, Table 8.1.A (page 111), and exact Opus 5.5 comparisons in sections 8.4, 8.5 and 8.7.1 give training descriptions and task scores, not total or active counts. Full-text size searches found no activated-parameter column or size-bearing named-base statement.

sources.title: Model Migration Guide - Migrating to Claude Opus 5.5
sources.evidence: Read October 27, 2026. The Opus 5.5 section calls it the successor to Opus 5 and documents the same tokenizer, context and output limits. These are compatibility facts; it does not identify Opus 5.5 as a size-preserving fine-tune or variant of a base with a published size, nor provide total or active counts.

name.note: Exact official display name and API identifier.

developer.note: System card identifies Anthropic as the model developer.

family.note: Catalog normalization of the exact system card designation as an Opus-class model.

release_date.note: Announcement and model specifications agree on the date.

open_weights.note: Explicit Claude nonpublic-weight policy applies to this model; hosted availability is separately documented.

license.note: Descriptive classification for a nonpublic-weight model offered under commercial service terms, not a named open-weight license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 re-audit found no developer-published nominal total in the reopened launch, specifications, exact card, transparency entry or later Sonnet/Haiku 5.5 comparisons. Focused exact-name parameter/billion/trillion and named-base searches found no supported numeric lead; results with numeric sizes described comparator models. Generic post-training and the documented Opus 5 succession/same tokenizer do not identify a size-bearing base. Lower serving compute and Fable-level performance do not establish size. The null reflects missing nominal disclosure, not a requirement for an exact tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 check separately found no nominal activated count or activated-parameter column in the exact-model specifications/card or later Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 comparison tables. Focused total/active/activated-parameter searches found no first-party count. Effort settings adjust test-time computation; tokenizer, context limits and lower serving cost do not determine active parameters. No total-to-active equality is inferred.

architecture.note: Inspected exact-model and later comparison sources do not identify an architecture. NLA/template-lens use does not itself establish Transformer or dense/MoE structure. No architecture is transferred from other Claude models or experimental checkpoints.

context_window.note: Exact current model specifications give 1M tokens.

modalities.note: Text/image input and text output are explicit. PDF is retained as the supported document format processed into text and page images.

reasoning.note: Dedicated adaptive thinking is always enabled; effort controls its depth.

tool_call.note: Official client and server function-calling examples name the exact model.

description.value: Claude Opus model with always-on adaptive thinking and a 1M-token context window.
description.note: Uses documented features without performance comparisons.

patch.notes: Nominal total and active parameter counts are undisclosed; published comparisons with Opus 5 and Fable 5.1 do not establish a size-preserving base relationship. Architecture remains undisclosed. Proprietary describes nonpublic weights accessed under commercial service terms. PDF input is document processing through text and vision.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retains null/undisclosed total and active counts after fresh launch, specifications, full exact/later-card, transparency and migration-guide checks. No nominal count, active-count column or supported size-bearing lineage was found; efficiency, tokenizer compatibility and benchmark parity do not establish size. Other assessments remain unchanged: 11 verified fields and 3 undisclosed.
